name: Jenner JR7-D — silhouette study
notes: Independent flattened pod-and-prow silhouette with forward cabin, four-armed drive deck and separate digitigrade hock linkage. No surface refinement. Shape review 2: lengthened tapered nose, narrowed laser nacelle roots, distinct upper glazing. Reference iteration 3: wide flat horizontal engine fuselage with hard wing edges, tapered prow with pitched window/canopy, compact flattened four-laser outriggers. Independent 10-point hull sections replace symmetric octagons. Reference iteration 4: narrow shins with articulated three-link silhouette, forward-facing broad three-toed feet and tall tapered hip housings; no generic plantigrade cylinders. Fifth pass: replace erroneously tall chimney with low slanted four-port SRM4 housing; underbelly mechanically joins horizontal engine pod to hip roots. Pass 6: distinctive paired upper/lower laser housings with separate physical muzzles and prominent nose glazing. Pass 7: independent three-toed digitigrade feet with shortened center instep, instead of a single wedge shoe. Shape pass 9: long aircraft-prow cockpit with pitched dark windscreen and angular nose chin, horizontal vented drive deck and smaller 35-ton chassis proportion. References TRO Jenner and contemporary tabletop sculpt.
